patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gorgias and Freshdesk share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Gorgias and Freshdesk share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Gorgias only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce helpdesk with ticket-based pricing — Starter $40/mo (50 tickets); Basic $77/mo a” rather than Freshdesk's shape. Choose Freshdesk only if your buying job matches “Helpdesk and omnichannel ticketing from Freshworks — Growth from $19/agent/mo annual with ” rather than Gorgias's shape. Workflow advantage: Gorgias leans ecommerce-support; Freshdesk leans omnichannel-support. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gorgias and Freshdesk share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Gorgias is Ecommerce helpdesk with ticket-based pricing — Starter $40/mo (50 tickets); Basic $77/mo annual ($90 monthly).; Freshdesk is Helpdesk and omnichannel ticketing from Freshworks — Growth from $19/agent/mo annual with 14-day trial..
- Company-size focus: Gorgias (small-business, mid-market) vs Freshdesk (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gorgias-leaning ecommerce-support vs Freshdesk-leaning omnichannel-support.
- Researched limits: Gorgias — Ticket caps on Starter/Basic — overages raise TCO quickly; Freshdesk — No published perpetual free plan — trial-only entry for paid tiers.

Limitations — Gorgias: Ticket caps on Starter/Basic — overages raise TCO quickly; Not per-agent pricing — high-volume teams need careful tier math; Freshdesk: No published perpetual free plan — trial-only entry for paid tiers; Freshworks suite overlap can confuse buyers choosing Freshdesk vs Freshchat vs Freshservice.

Poor-fit cases: Gorgias is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Ticket caps on Starter/Basic — overages raise TCO quickly · Freshdesk is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published perpetual free plan — trial-only entry for paid tiers · Avoid Gorgias if you actually need Freshdesk's motion (Helpdesk and omnichannel ticketing from Freshworks — Growth from $19/agent/mo an)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
